name: dashboard-shell-layout
title: Dashboard Shell Layout
description: Modern web application dashboard framework with collapsible sidebar, top command bar, and fluid widget grid.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Collapsible Sidebar Workspace: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
